description: Player's test battle on the two halves of the map (docs/ru/game/units/deployment.md: deployment areas centred X=-270/+270, Z=0, 400 x 260 m, facing each other): we attack from the west with a lord, 6 spearmen and 8 archers placed by our AI; the enemy — a lord, 8 spearmen, 6 archers — deploys and fights by the game's own AI in the east half. Build with --handover --enemy-ai native.
